trip_options.title: Budget Explorer - Disney World, Orlando, Florida
trip_options.description: Save money without sacrificing the experience. Perfect for travelers who value authentic local experiences over luxury.

hotel.name: Aegean Bliss Resort, Disney World, Orlando, Florida

day_by_day.morning: No activities — flight arrives late at night
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities — flight arrives late at night
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Orlando International Airport at 22:30 via Flight UA. Use Disney's Magical Express or a budget rideshare (Lyft/Uber) to reach Aegean Bliss Resort. Check in, unpack, and get settled. Pick up any essentials from the resort gift shop or a nearby convenience store.

meals.breakfast: On the plane or skip
meals.lunch: On the plane or airport food court before boarding
meals.dinner: Grab a quick late-night snack at the resort's lobby café or vending area to keep costs low

day_by_day.notes: Keep Day 1 light — rest is key before a full week of park adventures. Confirm park reservations and download the My Disney Experience app tonight. Pre-purchase park tickets in advance online for best budget pricing.

day_by_day.morning: Head to Magic Kingdom — arrive at rope drop (park opening, typically 9:00 AM) to maximize time before crowds build. Ride priority attractions: Space Mountain, Big Thunder Mountain Railroad, and Seven Dwarfs Mine Train using the Lightning Lane free tier. Explore Fantasyland and Tomorrowland.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue exploring Magic Kingdom — visit Liberty Square, Haunted Mansion, and Pirates of the Caribbean. Enjoy the afternoon parade (check schedule on the app). Take a mid-afternoon break at the resort to avoid peak heat and crowds, then return for the evening.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Magic Kingdom for the spectacular nighttime fireworks show 'Happily Ever After' (check schedule). Ride any remaining must-do attractions with shorter evening wait times. Head back to resort by 10:30 PM.

meals.breakfast: Bring a packed breakfast or grab quick items from a resort convenience store to save money before entering the park
meals.lunch: Columbia Harbour House in Liberty Square — budget-friendly counter service with clam chowder, fish & chips, and sandwiches (~$12–$15 per person)
meals.dinner: Cosmic Ray's Starlight Café in Tomorrowland — one of the best value counter-service spots in Magic Kingdom with burgers, chicken, and soups (~$12–$16 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Pack refillable water bottles — free ice water is available at any counter-service location. Wear comfortable shoes and apply sunscreen. June weather in Orlando is hot and humid (88–95°F) with afternoon thunderstorms possible.

day_by_day.morning: Visit EPCOT — arrive at rope drop. Start in World Discovery: ride Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind and Test Track. Then head to World Nature for Soarin' Around the World. Use the My Disney Experience app to grab Lightning Lane passes early.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore EPCOT's World Showcase — stroll through international pavilions (Mexico, Norway, China, Italy, France, etc.). Enjoy free cultural entertainment, street performers, and architecture. Try affordable international snacks from food booths around the lagoon.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for EPCOT's nighttime spectacular 'EPCOT Forever' or 'Luminous' (check current show schedule). Watch from the World Showcase lagoon for the best views. Return to resort by 10:00 PM.

meals.breakfast: Grab a quick bite at the resort or bring snacks into the park
meals.lunch: Sunshine Seasons in The Land pavilion — excellent value counter-service with rotisserie chicken, sandwiches, soups, and Asian noodle bowls (~$12–$15 per person)
meals.dinner: World Showcase food booths — budget tip: share 2–3 small plates between family members from different country pavilions for a fun, affordable international tasting experience (~$8–$12 per booth item)

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT is very walkable but large — comfortable shoes are a must. The World Showcase doesn't open until 11:00 AM, so plan World Discovery and World Nature first. Free refillable water stations are available throughout the park.

day_by_day.morning: Visit Hollywood Studios — arrive at rope drop. Head immediately to Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge for Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run (Rise of the Resistance requires early Lightning Lane booking — secure it the moment the park opens via the app). Explore Batuu and the immersive Star Wars land.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Toy Story Land — ride Slinky Dog Dash and Alien Swirling Saucers. Then head to Sunset Boulevard for Rock 'n' Roller Coaster and The Twilight Zone Tower of Terror. Watch the Indiana Jones Epic Stunt Spectacular show (check schedule).
day_by_day.evening: Stay for the Fantasmic! nighttime show (check schedule and arrive 45 minutes early for good seats — it's free with park admission). Catch any remaining rides with shorter evening wait times before heading back to the resort.

meals.breakfast: Pack snacks or eat at resort before departing
meals.lunch: Woody's Lunch Box in Toy Story Land — one of the most popular and affordable counter-service spots with toasted sandwiches, potato barrels, and lemonade (~$10–$14 per person)
meals.dinner: ABC Commissary near Echo Lake — budget-friendly counter service with burgers, chicken sandwiches, and international plates (~$12–$15 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Hollywood Studios is one of the most popular parks — rope drop strategy is critical here. Rise of the Resistance Lightning Lane sells out within minutes of park opening so have the app ready. Fantasmic! seating fills fast — plan accordingly.

day_by_day.morning: Visit Animal Kingdom — arrive at rope drop. Head directly to Pandora – The World of Avatar for Flight of Passage (the most in-demand ride at this park — Lightning Lane or early arrival is essential). Then ride Na'vi River Journey nearby.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Africa — ride Kilimanjaro Safaris (best in the morning or late afternoon for active animals). Walk the Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail for free wildlife viewing. Visit Asia for Expedition Everest and Kali River Rapids (prepare to get wet — great for hot June weather!).
day_by_day.evening: Stay for the Rivers of Light nighttime show or Tree of Life Awakenings (check current schedule — projections on the Tree of Life are stunning and free with park admission). Enjoy a relaxed evening stroll through Discovery Island before heading back to the resort.

meals.breakfast: Bring packed snacks or eat at resort before departing
meals.lunch: Flame Tree Barbecue in Discovery Island — one of the best-value counter-service meals at Disney with ribs, pulled pork, and chicken with beautiful outdoor waterfront seating (~$13–$17 per person)
meals.dinner: Satu'li Canteen in Pandora — healthy, flavorful bowls with grains, proteins, and sauces at reasonable Disney prices (~$13–$16 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Animal Kingdom typically closes earlier than other parks (check schedule). June heat makes Kali River Rapids a welcome attraction — bring a change of clothes or a poncho. The Safari is best experienced in the morning when animals are most active.

day_by_day.morning: Take a budget-friendly morning at Disney Springs — entry is completely FREE (no park ticket required). Explore the massive outdoor shopping, dining, and entertainment complex. Browse World of Disney (the largest Disney merchandise store), watch street performers, and enjoy the waterfront atmosphere.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to a favorite park for a half-day visit — use this as a flexible 'catch-up' day for any missed attractions or re-rides of favorites. Alternatively, enjoy the resort's pool and beach amenities at Aegean Bliss Resort for a relaxing, cost-free afternoon. Rest up for the final full park day.
day_by_day.evening: Dinner at Disney Springs — enjoy the free entertainment, live music, and people-watching. Explore the various dining options along the waterfront. Return to resort early for a good night's rest before the final park day.

meals.breakfast: Grab groceries from a nearby Publix or Walmart (accessible via rideshare) to stock up on breakfast items, snacks, and water for the remainder of the trip — huge money saver
meals.lunch: D-Luxe Burger at Disney Springs — quality burgers at relatively reasonable prices for Disney (~$12–$15). Or grab a quick flatbread from Blaze Fast-Fire'd Pizza (~$10–$12)
meals.dinner: The Polite Pig at Disney Springs — award-winning BBQ with smoked meats, craft sides, and cocktails at moderate prices (~$14–$18 per person). Budget tip: share plates between family members

day_by_day.notes: Disney Springs parking is FREE in all garages. This is a great day to do laundry at the resort, recharge devices, and reorganize bags for the final push. Stock up on any medications, sunscreen, or snacks at a grocery store to avoid expensive park prices.

day_by_day.morning: Return to your favorite park or choose one with missed attractions — Magic Kingdom is ideal for a grand finale. Arrive at rope drop and use the My Disney Experience app to grab any remaining Lightning Lane passes. Prioritize your absolute must-do rides and experiences.
day_by_day.afternoon: Enjoy a leisurely lunch and final souvenir shopping within the park. Take photos at iconic locations — Cinderella Castle, Main Street USA, etc. Ride any final favorites and soak in the last moments of the Disney magic.
day_by_day.evening: End the trip with the ultimate Disney send-off — watch the Magic Kingdom fireworks one final time (if not seen on Day 2, or simply enjoy them again). Grab a Mickey ice cream bar from a street cart as a classic Disney farewell treat. Return to resort, pack bags, and prepare for departure. Reflect on an amazing week!

meals.breakfast: Use remaining groceries from the resort room for a cost-saving final morning breakfast
meals.lunch: Pecos Bill Tall Tale Inn and Café in Frontierland — classic counter service with burgers, fajita bowls, and a generous toppings bar (~$12–$15 per person)
meals.dinner: Casey's Corner on Main Street USA — iconic hot dogs and corn dog nuggets for a fun, affordable final Disney dinner (~$8–$12 per person). Perfect for eating while watching the evening entertainment

day_by_day.notes: Check resort checkout time and arrange luggage storage if needed for a late departure. Use Disney's resort airline check-in service if available to check bags at the resort. Budget recap tip: By using counter-service dining, packing snacks and water, visiting Disney Springs on a rest day, and buying tickets in advance, a family of 4 can save $300–$500+ over the week compared to table-service dining and last-minute purchases.

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled — flight arrives late night
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities scheduled — flight arrives late night
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Orlando International Airport at 22:30 via United Airlines. Collect luggage, arrange ground transportation (Mears Connect shuttle or rideshare ~$35-45) to Aegean Bliss Resort at Disney World. Check in, settle into your Beachfront room, and do a quick unpack to prepare for the week ahead.

meals.breakfast: On the flight or grab a quick bite at the airport before departure
meals.lunch: On the flight or at the airport
meals.dinner: Pick up a light late-night snack from the resort's lobby convenience area or a quick-service spot still open near check-in. Keep it simple — you have a big week ahead!

day_by_day.notes: Flight arrives at 22:30, so no park activities today. Confirm your resort reservation in advance and download the My Disney Experience app before arrival. Pre-link your park tickets and make any dining reservations you want for the week. Get to bed early — Day 2 starts bright and early!

day_by_day.morning: Magic Kingdom Park Full Day Adventure (Part 1): Head to Magic Kingdom early using Disney's complimentary resort transportation. Arrive at rope drop (~9:00 AM) to beat the crowds. Start with fan favorites in Fantasyland — Peter Pan's Flight, The Haunted Mansion, and 'it's a small world.' Use Lightning Lane passes for Space Mountain and Seven Dwarfs Mine Train to maximize your morning.
day_by_day.afternoon: Magic Kingdom Park Full Day Adventure (Part 2): After lunch, explore Adventureland (Pirates of the Caribbean, Jungle Cruise) and Liberty Square. Take a mid-afternoon break at the resort if needed (resort guests can re-enter easily) or cool off with a Dole Whip near Adventureland. Return refreshed for the late afternoon and tackle Big Thunder Mountain Railroad and Tomorrowland attractions.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for the Magic Kingdom nighttime spectacular — the 'Disney Enchantment' fireworks and projection show over Cinderella Castle (typically around 9:00 PM). Grab a prime viewing spot on Main Street U.S.A. at least 30 minutes early. Ride one last favorite before the park closes, then take the monorail or ferry back to your resort transportation.

meals.breakfast: Grab a quick breakfast at the resort before heading out — most Disney resorts offer a grab-and-go option or a casual breakfast restaurant. Budget ~$15-20 per person.
meals.lunch: Columbia Harbour House in Liberty Square — a mid-range quick-service spot offering clam chowder, lobster rolls, and fried chicken. Great value and shorter lines than many Magic Kingdom spots. ~$15-18 per person.
meals.dinner: The Plaza Restaurant on Main Street U.S.A. — a charming table-service spot with classic American fare (sandwiches, burgers, pasta). Reservations recommended. ~$25-35 per person.

day_by_day.notes: Purchase Individual Lightning Lane selections for Space Mountain and Seven Dwarfs Mine Train early in the morning via the My Disney Experience app — these sell out fast. Wear comfortable shoes and bring sunscreen and a refillable water bottle. Orlando in June is hot and humid (expect 90°F+), so stay hydrated and take shade breaks.

day_by_day.morning: EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour (Part 1): Take Disney transportation to EPCOT and enter through the main entrance. Start in Future World (now called World Discovery & World Nature) — ride Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind and Test Track early before lines build. Then make your way to the World Showcase, which opens at 11:00 AM. Begin your cultural journey in Mexico (the pyramid pavilion), then wind through Norway, China, Germany, and Italy.
day_by_day.afternoon: EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour (Part 2): Continue through the American Adventure, Japan, Morocco, France, United Kingdom, and Canada pavilions. Sample 2-3 signature dishes or snacks from different countries — a crêpe in France, sushi in Japan, fish and chips in the UK. Catch a live cultural performance or two along the World Showcase promenade. Also ride Remy's Ratatouille Adventure in the France pavilion (get Lightning Lane or arrive early).
day_by_day.evening: Stay for EPCOT's 'EPCOT Forever' or 'Harmonious' nighttime spectacular over World Showcase Lagoon — one of the largest nighttime shows Disney has ever created. Watch from the International Gateway bridge or the UK/France waterfront for the best views. Wind down with a dessert from one of the World Showcase kiosks before heading back to the resort.

meals.breakfast: Enjoy breakfast at the resort's main restaurant for a relaxed start before heading to EPCOT. ~$15-20 per person.
meals.lunch: World Showcase food crawl — budget $20-25 for a collection of small plates and snacks across 3-4 pavilions. Highlights: School Bread from Norway's Kringla Bakeri, Beef Short Rib from Mexico's La Cantina de San Angel, and Croissant Doughnut from France.
meals.dinner: Via Napoli Ristorante e Pizzeria in the Italy Pavilion — an authentic Neapolitan pizzeria with wood-fired pies, pasta, and Italian wine. A mid-range table-service gem. Reservations strongly recommended. ~$30-40 per person.

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT is a large park — comfortable walking shoes are essential. The World Showcase is perfect for families who enjoy food and culture. If traveling with young children, Remy's Ratatouille Adventure and Frozen Ever After (Norway) are must-dos. The EPCOT app map helps navigate between pavilions efficiently.

day_by_day.morning: Disney's Animal Kingdom Safari & Avatar Experience (Part 1): Take resort transportation to Animal Kingdom, arriving at rope drop. Head straight to Pandora — The World of Avatar for Flight of Passage (the park's most popular ride — Lightning Lane highly recommended) and Na'vi River Journey. The bioluminescent theming of Pandora is stunning even in daylight. Arrive early to soak in the immersive atmosphere before crowds build.
day_by_day.afternoon: Disney's Animal Kingdom Safari & Avatar Experience (Part 2): After Pandora, head to Africa for the Kilimanjaro Safaris — a 20-minute open-air vehicle tour spotting real African wildlife including elephants, giraffes, lions, hippos, and rhinos. This is a highlight of any Disney World trip. Then explore Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail on foot. Visit Asia for Expedition Everest roller coaster and Kali River Rapids (get ready to get wet — great in June heat!).
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy Animal Kingdom's Rivers of Light evening show (check current schedule) or the Tree of Life Awakenings — a stunning projection show on the park's iconic 14-story tree that runs every few minutes at night. Take time to walk Discovery Island and admire the incredible animal carvings on the Tree of Life up close. Head back to the resort for a relaxing evening by the Beachfront pool.

meals.breakfast: Grab a quick breakfast at the resort or pick up a pastry and coffee at Creature Comforts (Starbucks) inside Animal Kingdom near the entrance.
meals.lunch: Satu'li Canteen in Pandora — Animal Kingdom's best quick-service restaurant. Customizable bowls with proteins like chili-spiced beef or sustainable fish over grains and greens. Flavorful, filling, and mid-range priced. ~$16-20 per person.
meals.dinner: Tiffins Restaurant at Animal Kingdom — a signature table-service restaurant celebrating the art of travel. Stunning decor and globally-inspired cuisine (think whole-fried sustainable fish, plant-based dishes, and creative cocktails). A slight splurge but worth it for a special dinner. ~$45-60 per person. Alternatively, Yak & Yeti Restaurant in Asia is a solid mid-range option at ~$25-35.

day_by_day.notes: Animal Kingdom closes earlier than other parks (often by 8-9 PM), so plan accordingly. Kilimanjaro Safaris is best in the morning when animals are most active. Bring a change of clothes or a poncho if riding Kali River Rapids. The park has excellent shade and tree cover, making it slightly more bearable in June heat compared to other parks.

day_by_day.morning: Hollywood Studios Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Experience (Part 1): Take resort transportation to Hollywood Studios and make a beeline for Galaxy's Edge at park open. Visit Savi's Workshop to build a custom lightsaber (~$249.99 — a splurge but an unforgettable experience; book in advance) or the Droid Depot to build a custom droid (~$119.99). These experiences sell out quickly. Alternatively, browse Dok-Ondar's Den of Antiquities for collectibles and immerse yourself in the fully realized Black Spire Outpost environment.
day_by_day.afternoon: Hollywood Studios Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Experience (Part 2) + More: Ride Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance — one of the most technologically advanced theme park attractions ever built (Lightning Lane recommended). Then ride Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run for a fun interactive co-pilot experience. After Galaxy's Edge, explore the rest of Hollywood Studios: Toy Story Land (Slinky Dog Dash, Toy Story Mania), and Tower of Terror for thrills.
day_by_day.evening: Cap the Hollywood Studios day with the 'Fantasmic!' nighttime show — a spectacular outdoor amphitheater production featuring Mickey Mouse battling Disney villains with water screens, pyrotechnics, and live performers. Check show times and arrive 30-45 minutes early for good seats. End the night with a stroll down Hollywood Boulevard before heading back to the resort.

meals.breakfast: Breakfast at the resort before departing. Alternatively, grab a quick bite at Trolley Car Café (Starbucks) on Hollywood Boulevard inside the park.
meals.lunch: Docking Bay 7 Food and Cargo in Galaxy's Edge — a Star Wars-themed quick-service restaurant with creative dishes like Smoked Kaadu Ribs and Fried Endorian Tip-Yip (essentially ribs and chicken, but the theming is incredible). ~$16-22 per person.
meals.dinner: 50's Prime Time Café — a nostalgic, fun table-service restaurant themed like a 1950s American kitchen. Servers stay in character as 'mom' and the menu features comfort food classics like pot roast, meatloaf, and milkshakes. Great for families. ~$25-35 per person. Reservations recommended.

day_by_day.notes: Savi's Workshop and Droid Depot reservations must be made well in advance through the My Disney Experience app — they book out weeks ahead. Rise of the Resistance is the most sought-after Lightning Lane in the park; purchase it the moment the window opens at 7:00 AM. Hollywood Studios is very walkable and compact compared to other parks.

day_by_day.morning: Resort Relaxation Morning: Take a well-deserved rest morning at the Aegean Bliss Resort. Sleep in, enjoy a leisurely breakfast, and spend time at the resort's Beachfront pool. This is a great opportunity to recharge mid-trip, especially if traveling with children. Take a walk along the resort's beachfront area, enjoy water activities, or simply relax with a book and a poolside drink.
day_by_day.afternoon: Disney Springs Entertainment & Dining (Part 1): Head to Disney Springs in the early afternoon — it's free admission and easily accessible via resort shuttle. Browse the unique shopping options including The LEGO Store (with its massive outdoor LEGO sculptures), World of Disney (the largest Disney merchandise store on property), and specialty shops. Check out the live entertainment on the waterfront stages and the unique architecture of the Town Center, Marketplace, and Landing districts.
day_by_day.evening: Disney Springs Entertainment & Dining Evening (Part 2): Enjoy the vibrant evening atmosphere at Disney Springs. Catch a show at the AMC Disney Springs 24 movie theater, visit the Splitsville Luxury Lanes (bowling + dining combo — great for families), or enjoy live music at one of the outdoor venues. The waterfront area is especially lively at night with street performers and ambient entertainment.

meals.breakfast: Leisurely resort breakfast — enjoy the full resort restaurant experience with a relaxed sit-down meal. ~$18-25 per person.
meals.lunch: Wolfgang Puck Bar & Grill at Disney Springs — a stylish yet approachable restaurant from celebrity chef Wolfgang Puck. Great wood-fired pizzas, salads, and American comfort dishes with a gourmet twist. ~$25-35 per person.
meals.dinner: The BOATHOUSE at Disney Springs — a waterfront seafood and steak restaurant with stunning views of the springs. Known for its fresh seafood towers, hand-cut steaks, and Amphicar Tours (vintage amphibious vehicle rides on the water). Mid-to-upscale range. ~$40-55 per person. Reservations strongly recommended. Alternatively, Chicken Guy! by Guy Fieri for a fun, affordable quick-service option at ~$12-15.

day_by_day.notes: Disney Springs is open to the general public with no park ticket required, making it a perfect lower-key day. Parking is free (self-parking garages available). The evening atmosphere is particularly magical with lights reflecting off the water. This is a great day to do any last-minute souvenir shopping or to revisit favorite shops from earlier in the trip.

day_by_day.morning: Final Resort Morning & Farewell: Enjoy one last morning at the Aegean Bliss Resort. Take a sunrise walk along the beachfront, enjoy a final resort breakfast, and begin packing and checking out. If checkout allows, leave luggage with the bell services desk and spend a couple of final hours at the resort pool or exploring the property. Pick up any last-minute souvenirs at the resort gift shop.
day_by_day.afternoon: Depending on your flight time: If you have an afternoon or evening flight, consider a final few hours at a nearby Disney park (EPCOT is great for a quick revisit to grab a snack or ride a favorite), or explore the Disney resort area one last time. Arrange resort transportation or a rideshare to Orlando International Airport with plenty of time to spare (allow 60-90 minutes for travel + check-in + security).
day_by_day.evening: Depart Orlando and head home with a lifetime of Disney memories. Review your photos, share your favorite moments, and start planning your next Disney adventure!

meals.breakfast: Final resort breakfast — treat yourself to a full sit-down meal to properly close out the trip. ~$18-25 per person.
meals.lunch: Quick-service meal at Disney Springs or inside a park if you visit, OR grab a bite at Orlando International Airport. Many airports now have quality dining options beyond fast food. ~$15-20 per person.
meals.dinner: Airport dining or on the flight home.

day_by_day.notes: Check your resort's checkout time (typically 11:00 AM) and arrange bell services for luggage storage if needed. Orlando International Airport is large — allow extra time for security, especially during summer peak season. Consider enrolling in TSA PreCheck if you haven't already. The Mears Connect shared shuttle from Disney resorts to the airport runs regularly and costs ~$35-45 per person round trip. Confirm your return transportation the night before.

highlights: Mix of paid and free experiences

day_by_day.afternoon: No activities scheduled — in transit
day_by_day.evening: Late arrival at Orlando International Airport at 22:30 via United Airlines. A pre-arranged private luxury transfer (limousine or black SUV) whisks you directly to Aegean Bliss Resort at Disney World. Check in to your Beachfront suite, enjoy a welcome amenity, and settle in for the night.

meals.breakfast: In-flight or at airport prior to departure
meals.lunch: In-flight or at airport
meals.dinner: Light late-night welcome snack and curated minibar selections arranged in your suite upon arrival — coordinate with the resort concierge in advance for charcuterie, fresh fruit, and sparkling wine

day_by_day.notes: Pre-arrange private airport transfer through the resort concierge before departure. Request early check-in luggage storage if needed. Confirm suite is stocked with welcome amenities. Get a good night's rest — the magic begins tomorrow.

day_by_day.morning: Leisurely resort morning — enjoy a lavish breakfast at the Aegean Bliss Resort's signature waterfront restaurant. Take time to explore the beachfront property, pool area, and resort amenities. Meet with the resort's dedicated Disney concierge to confirm park reservations, Lightning Lane Multi Pass selections, and dining reservations for the week.
day_by_day.afternoon: Disney Springs Entertainment & Dining Afternoon — head to Disney Springs for a relaxed, no-ticket-required introduction to the Disney experience. Browse flagship stores including World of Disney, LEGO, and luxury boutiques. Explore the entertainment district, catch a live performance, and soak in the vibrant atmosphere along the waterfront.
day_by_day.evening: Dinner at The BOATHOUSE at Disney Springs, one of the most acclaimed upscale dining destinations on Disney property. Enjoy premium steaks, fresh seafood, and craft cocktails on the waterfront terrace. After dinner, stroll the illuminated Disney Springs promenade and browse evening entertainment options including live music venues.

meals.breakfast: Aegean Bliss Resort signature waterfront restaurant — full à la carte breakfast with fresh-squeezed juices, eggs Benedict, smoked salmon platters, and premium coffee service
meals.lunch: Chef Art Smith's Homecomin' at Disney Springs — indulgent Southern comfort cuisine with fried chicken, deviled eggs, and craft cocktails in an upscale farmhouse setting
meals.dinner: The BOATHOUSE at Disney Springs — prime dry-aged steaks, Maine lobster, oysters on the half shell, and an extensive wine list in a nautical luxury atmosphere

day_by_day.notes: Disney Springs is free admission with no park ticket required — perfect for an easy first full day. Use this day to rest, recharge, and plan the week ahead with the concierge. Book Lightning Lane Individual Attraction selections for the week's park days as early as possible.

day_by_day.morning: Magic Kingdom Park Full Day Adventure — arrive at rope drop (park opening) for the full Magic Kingdom experience. Begin with fan-favorite rides before crowds build: Seven Dwarfs Mine Train, Space Mountain, and Big Thunder Mountain Railroad. Use Lightning Lane Multi Pass strategically to minimize wait times throughout the day. Enjoy the iconic Main Street U.S.A. atmosphere and grab a Dole Whip at Aloha Isle.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue exploring Magic Kingdom's lands — Fantasyland, Tomorrowland, and Adventureland. Experience Pirates of the Caribbean, the Haunted Mansion, and Tron Lightcycle / Run (book Lightning Lane Individual for this). Take a mid-afternoon break at the resort if energy dips — utilize the complimentary Disney resort transportation for a quick return and refresh.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Magic Kingdom for the spectacular nighttime entertainment. Secure a premium viewing spot for the Happily Ever After fireworks spectacular and the Main Street Electrical Parade. Dine at Be Our Guest Restaurant inside the park for an enchanting dinner inside Beast's Castle.

meals.breakfast: Aegean Bliss Resort in-room dining — continental breakfast delivered to your suite before the early park departure
meals.lunch: Columbia Harbour House or Skipper Canteen inside Magic Kingdom — table service lunch with a relaxing air-conditioned atmosphere
meals.dinner: Be Our Guest Restaurant, Magic Kingdom — prix-fixe dinner inside the iconic Beast's Castle with French-inspired cuisine, fine wines, and immersive theming (advance reservation essential)

day_by_day.notes: Purchase Lightning Lane Multi Pass and Individual Lightning Lane for Tron Lightcycle / Run at 7:00 AM on the day of visit. Wear comfortable shoes and bring portable fans or cooling towels for June heat. The resort's private transportation makes mid-day breaks seamless and highly recommended for families.

day_by_day.morning: EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour — arrive at EPCOT for park opening and head immediately to the Future World attractions: Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind (book Lightning Lane Individual in advance), Test Track, and Soarin' Around the World. Explore the stunning new World Discovery and World Nature neighborhoods.
day_by_day.afternoon: Transition into the World Showcase as it opens at 11:00 AM. Embark on a curated food and beverage tour across all 11 country pavilions — sample authentic dishes, artisan wines, craft beers, and specialty cocktails from Mexico, Norway, China, Germany, Italy, America, Japan, Morocco, France, United Kingdom, and Canada. Engage with live cultural performers and artisans in each pavilion.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for EPCOT's breathtaking EPCOT Forever or Harmonious nighttime spectacular over World Showcase Lagoon — one of the most visually stunning shows on Disney property. Dine at one of EPCOT's premier table-service restaurants before the show.

meals.breakfast: Aegean Bliss Resort signature restaurant — hot breakfast buffet with international selections to fuel a full park day
meals.lunch: World Showcase food tour — curated small plates and tastings across multiple pavilions including La Hacienda de San Angel (Mexico), Takumi-Tei (Japan), and Chefs de France (France)
meals.dinner: Monsieur Paul, EPCOT — an exquisite fine-dining French restaurant on the second floor of the France Pavilion, offering an award-winning menu with sommelier-selected wine pairings in an intimate, elegant setting (advance reservation essential)

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT's World Showcase food tour is best enjoyed at a leisurely pace — budget 3–4 hours to properly explore all pavilions. Monsieur Paul is one of the most exclusive dining experiences on Disney property; book well in advance. June evenings at EPCOT are warm — the lagoon-side breeze makes the nighttime show viewing pleasant.

day_by_day.morning: Hollywood Studios Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Experience — arrive at Hollywood Studios for rope drop and head directly to Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge. Reserve your spot for the Savi's Workshop Handbuilt Lightsaber experience (book in advance — $300+ per saber, limited availability). This immersive 20-minute ceremony is a premium highlight of any Disney visit. Afterward, pilot the Millennium Falcon on Smugglers Run.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue the Hollywood Studios adventure — experience Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance (Lightning Lane Individual essential), Toy Story Land's Slinky Dog Dash and Alien Swirling Saucers, and The Twilight Zone Tower of Terror. Explore the Droid Depot to build a custom interactive droid companion. Enjoy the incredible atmosphere of a galaxy far, far away.
day_by_day.evening: Experience the Star Wars: A Galactic Spectacular nighttime show — a stunning projection and fireworks display over the park. Cap the night with dinner at a premium Hollywood Studios dining venue before departing for the resort.

meals.breakfast: Aegean Bliss Resort in-room dining — early breakfast delivered to the suite for a prompt park departure
meals.lunch: Oga's Cantina, Galaxy's Edge — the most immersive bar experience in Walt Disney World, featuring exotic cocktails (alcoholic and non-alcoholic), DJ R-3X spinning intergalactic beats, and unique Star Wars-themed bites (reservations open 60 days in advance and fill instantly)
meals.dinner: Hollywood Brown Derby, Hollywood Studios — a recreation of the legendary 1930s Hollywood restaurant featuring the original Cobb Salad, premium steaks, and an extensive wine list in an art deco setting

day_by_day.notes: Savi's Workshop reservations open 60 days in advance at 7:00 AM EST and sell out within minutes — set a reminder and book the moment the window opens. Oga's Cantina has a 45-minute time limit per visit and also requires advance reservations. Lightning Lane Individual for Rise of the Resistance should be purchased at 7:00 AM on the day of visit.

day_by_day.morning: Disney's Animal Kingdom Safari & Avatar Experience — arrive at Animal Kingdom for rope drop. Begin immediately with the Kilimanjaro Safaris for the best wildlife viewing in the cooler morning hours. Spot lions, elephants, giraffes, hippos, and more across the 110-acre savanna. Follow with the Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail for up-close wildlife encounters.
day_by_day.afternoon: Journey to Pandora — The World of Avatar for the afternoon. Experience Avatar Flight of Passage (Lightning Lane Individual is a must — this is the most in-demand ride in Walt Disney World). Follow with the Na'vi River Journey for a serene, beautifully immersive boat ride through a bioluminescent rainforest. Explore the stunning Pandora landscape, which transforms magically as daylight shifts.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for the stunning Rivers of Light nighttime spectacular at Animal Kingdom (check current show schedule). Enjoy a premium farewell dinner at Tiffins Restaurant, Animal Kingdom's flagship fine-dining establishment, before returning to the resort for a relaxing evening at the beachfront pool or spa.

meals.breakfast: Aegean Bliss Resort — light grab-and-go breakfast from the resort's café for an early Animal Kingdom arrival
meals.lunch: Satu'li Canteen, Pandora — The World of Avatar — creative bowls and unique Avatar-themed cuisine in a visually stunning setting
meals.dinner: Tiffins Restaurant, Animal Kingdom — Disney's most artistically curated fine-dining experience, celebrating global exploration with an adventurous menu of international flavors, premium wine and cocktail pairings, and gallery-quality art throughout the restaurant

day_by_day.notes: Animal Kingdom's wildlife is most active in the early morning — arriving at rope drop is essential for the best Kilimanjaro Safaris experience. Avatar Flight of Passage Lightning Lane Individual should be secured at 7:00 AM. The park typically closes earlier than other Disney parks, so plan your schedule accordingly. Tiffins is one of the most critically acclaimed restaurants on Disney property — book 60 days in advance.

day_by_day.morning: Leisurely final morning at Aegean Bliss Resort — enjoy a long, indulgent breakfast at the resort's waterfront restaurant. Take a final stroll along the beachfront, enjoy the pool, or book a morning spa treatment at the resort spa for a rejuvenating send-off. Pack and prepare for checkout.
day_by_day.afternoon: Late checkout (arrange with concierge — typically available for premium suite guests). Use remaining time for last-minute souvenir shopping at Disney Springs or the resort's boutique shops. Alternatively, visit the resort's pool and beach one final time for a relaxing farewell to Orlando.
day_by_day.evening: Private luxury transfer from Aegean Bliss Resort to Orlando International Airport. Allow ample travel time accounting for Orlando traffic and airport check-in. Enjoy dinner at the airport's premium lounges or a final Orlando dining experience near the airport if departure time permits.

meals.breakfast: Aegean Bliss Resort signature waterfront restaurant — full à la carte farewell breakfast with champagne service, smoked salmon, fresh pastries, and premium coffee — a luxurious final morning treat
meals.lunch: Resort poolside bar and grill — casual farewell lunch with gourmet burgers, fresh salads, and tropical cocktails by the beachfront
meals.dinner: Airport premium lounge dining or The Capital Grille, Orlando — an upscale steakhouse near the airport offering dry-aged steaks, fresh seafood, and an exceptional wine list for a memorable final Orlando dinner

day_by_day.notes: Confirm late checkout with the concierge at least 48 hours in advance — premium suite guests typically receive complimentary late checkout until 2:00 PM. Pre-arrange private airport transfer for the return journey. Allow at least 3 hours before departure for Orlando International Airport check-in and security. Request the resort to ship any bulky souvenir purchases directly to your home address to avoid baggage complications.

query: Disney World Orlando family of 4, $6000, 7 days, June 2026
